name: vllm-sr/d3-ultra
title: vLLM Semantic Router releases d3-ultra, an open 27B multimodal decision model
summary: d3-ultra is a 26B-parameter open-weights model under Apache-2.0. It outputs structured decisions (choice, yes/no, score, bounding box, and tracking across video frames) and has a 131K context. On one AMD MI325X, the team reports 304 ms for a single question and 2.16 s for a batch of 255. Its benchmark scores (SR-Text 87.2, SR-Box 58.2%, and #2 of 230 on the Jev Decision Index text board) come from
